problems.stem: Your slide deck must persuade a campus hiring panel to invite you to interview in a 3-minute slot. Which storyboard line shows the deck is built for that audience and purpose?
options: Slide 1: 'About Me' with a full-screen photo and a decorative title font.
Slide 1 takeaway: 'Invite this candidate.' Slide 2: one quantified project result. Slide 3: skill-to-role match. Total 3 slides for 3 minutes.
Twelve slides covering every course project in chronological order.
A single slide of bullet points copied from the resume.
problems.explanation: The audience (hiring panel) and purpose (earn an interview) drive a tight 3-slide scope sized to the 3-minute limit.

problems.stem: You ask BigAL for help on this deck. Which note names the audience-purpose decision well enough for targeted feedback?
options: This deck looks good to me.
My audience is a hiring panel and my purpose is an interview invite, but slide 4 explains a class assignment they will not care about. Should I cut it?
problems.explanation: The strong note names audience, purpose, and the specific slide that may not serve them, so feedback can be exact.

problems.stem: What is a defensible way to use AI while setting purpose and audience for this deck?
options: Ask AI to generate the whole deck and present it unchanged.
Ask AI to list questions a hiring panel might have, then you decide which one each slide answers.
Let AI invent an audience for you so you do not have to.
Use AI only to pick a slide theme color.
problems.explanation: AI surfaces candidate audience questions; you keep authorship of which question each slide actually serves.

problems.stem: A reviewer says your purpose statement is vague. Which revision makes the purpose inspectable?
options: 'My purpose is to talk about my work.'
'After 3 minutes the hiring panel should be able to say why my data project qualifies me for the analyst internship.'
'My purpose is to use nice slides.'
'My purpose is to finish the assignment.'
problems.explanation: A testable purpose names the audience, the time, and the exact judgment they should be able to make.
